# v0.5.0 — OWL EL classifier & query

## Highlights

- **`ontologos-el`**: ELK-style completion-based OWL EL classification with taxonomy extraction
- **`ontologos-query`**: query direct subclasses, subsumption, equivalences, and unsatisfiable classes
- **CLI**: `ontologos classify --profile el|rl|rdfs|auto` (HermiT/Protégé-aligned semantics)
- **Python**: `profile="el"` and `profile="auto"` supported; taxonomy dict on `classify()`
- **Parser**: decompose `SubClassOf` with `ObjectIntersectionOf` for EL corpora

## Migration

See [docs/migration/v0.4.x-to-v0.5.0.md](../../docs/migration/v0.4.x-to-v0.5.0.md). CLI `classify` no longer defaults to RDFS-only — use `materialize` or `--profile rdfs`.

## Published crates

- `ontologos-el` 0.5.0
- `ontologos-query` 0.5.0
- Workspace crates bumped to 0.5.0
